rules.statement: A Kandyan deed of gift is generally revocable unless the circumstances which constitute non-revocability appear most clearly on the face of the deed itself.
rules.supporting_quote: "In my opinion the ruling laid down by the Full Court in Bologna v. Punchi Mahatmeya, 1 taken in conjunction with the ruling of the Full Court in Kirimenika v. Ganrala and others, 3 should guide the decisions of this Court in determining whether or not a Kandyan deed of gift is revocable or not."
